ازدلفتم (form VIII)
# اِزْدَلَفْتُمْ (izdalaftum) /iz.da.laf.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
# اُزْدُلِفْتُمْ (uzduliftum) /uz.du.lif.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِزْدَلَفَ (izdalafa)
